fit_linear_model: fit a LinearModel on univariate time series data using OLS regression with statsmodels
predict_linear_forecast: predict future values with a fitted LinearModel returning forecast, lower, and upper confidence bounds
create_linear_model_params: create LinearModelParams with a custom alpha value for confidence interval width
get_linear_param_search_space: get the default parameter search space for alpha values in the LinearModel
predict_with_history: predict with a fitted LinearModel including historical data in the returned forecast dataframe
